# Fastighetsanalytikern: Två aktier med potential

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-09-09  
**Market Sentiment**: Positive

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A property-sector analyst, the guest Mikael, says it is hard to get property cases across while sentiment on the sector is this negative. He argues the cases worth pitching are undervalued names or companies that can reallocate capital, for example through buybacks. His top picks are Stendörren and Logistea, and he supports a merger of the two. He also sees upside in Wihlborgs despite the criticism of its Castellum portfolio purchase. Other themes are the value of data-center land and office vacancies leveling off in Swedish cities.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 STEF-B — Stendörren | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Guest analyst's firm has a buy rating and sees 20-25% upside over one year. Building-rights portfolio is not priced by the market.

#### Reasoning

The guest analyst says Stendörren is fundamentally undervalued. By his estimate the 650,000 sqm building-rights portfolio on the outskirts of Stockholm has large value the market ignores. He calls it one of the two names his firm has pitched hardest to clients. A possible data-center angle (powered land) is upside, though he warns against pricing in building permits directly. EQT's overhang and weak sector sentiment could delay a re-rating.

#### Sell Triggers

- EQT sells its ~40% stake
- property sector sentiment keeps falling
- no capital allocation such as buybacks
- data-center permit lacks a secured power connection date

> *"Vi gillar bolaget. Vi har köprekommendation. Vi ser en ganska stor uppsida på ett års sikt. Vi pratar nog i termer av 20-25 %"*

---

### 🟢 LOGI-B — Logistea | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Called one of the best cases in the sector. EPS growing strongly with no new equity needed. Second commentator also calls it very cheap.

#### Reasoning

The guest analyst has long seen Logistea as one of the best property cases. It has grown EPS enormously and can keep expanding without raising equity. His firm has pitched it hardest alongside Stendörren. A second commentator agrees it looks really cheap but notes messy ownership and sellers wanting out. The analyst supports a Logistea-Stendörren merger for synergies and better share liquidity.

#### Sell Triggers

- continued selling by exiting owners
- need to raise new equity
- EPS growth stalls

> *"Vi har länge tyckt att Logistea är kanske ett av de bästa casen i sektorn."*

---

### 🟢 WIHL — Wihlborgs | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Down ~12% YTD. Strong cash-flow yield and a discount to net asset value. Share-issue fear seen as overdone. Local management could improve returns on the Castellum portfolio.

#### Reasoning

The guest analyst has no official equity coverage, only credit coverage. On his estimates, the cash-flow yield on the current market value is very good. He thinks the stock was punished too hard for poor communication around the SEK 13.3bn Castellum purchase. He expects debt to be cut through asset sales rather than a share issue at current price levels. Local teams and adjacent properties should help fill vacancies over time, and office vacancies are leveling off.

#### Sell Triggers

- new share issue announced
- vacancy rate fails to come down
- loan-to-value keeps rising without asset sales

> *"Så Wihlborgs är absolut värda att göra jobbet på."*

---

### 🟠 CATE — Catena | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

Mentioned in passing: has fallen on the stock market and may look fairly cheap after some work.

#### Reasoning

The guest analyst mentioned Catena as another large logistics property company that has fallen, where some analysis could show it looks fairly cheap. There was no explicit recommendation.

#### Sell Triggers

- logistics property sentiment worsens further

> *"jag menar Catena Ett annat stort bolag som har kommit ner på börsen. Där kan man nog göra lite jobb och hitta att det ser ganska billigt ut."*

---
